detail.title: CP-NNR-4K332R4-16P-32 Ch. H.265+ 4K AI Network Video Recorder | Cp Plus | Cpplusworld.com
features: Up to 32 channel IP camera input
Up to 16 face databases with 10,000 face images in total
Up to 32ch picture stream face recognition
Simultaneous HDMI and VGA up to 4K output
Support 4 SATA Ports, up to 12TB Each, 3 USB Ports, 1 eSATA Port, 16 PoE Ports

General.Playback: Play, Pause, Stop, Rewind, Fast play, Slow play, Next file, Previous file, Next camera, Previous camera, Full screen, Repeat, Shuffle, Backup selection, Digital zoom
General.Performance: Max 20 face pictures /sec processing 32ch picture stream face recognition
General.Stranger Mode: Detect strangers' faces (not in device's face database) Similarity threshold can be set manually
General.Recording Mode: Manual, Schedule (Regular, Continuous, Motion Detection, Video Loss, Camera Tamper, Alarm in, IVS
General.Database Management: Up to 16 face databases with 10,000 face images in total
General.Database Application: Every data can be applied to any channel
General.Trigger Events Face Recognition: Buzzer, Alarm push, Alarm prompt, Email, Alarm Out, Compare the result simultaneously, etc.
General.AI Search: Search for image by image Search image by properties
General.Face: Face comparison results (registrant (name and ID), stranger, channel, similarity)
General.Interface Ports: 1 HDMI, 1 VGA, 3 ports (USB 2.0 x2, USB3.0 x1), 1 RS485, 1 RS232
General.Trigger Events: Recording, Buzzer, Push message, Pop up message.
General.Hard Disk: 4 SATA Ports, up to 12TB for each HDD, 1 eSATA Port
General.Protocols: HTTP, HTTPS, TCP/IP, IPv4, UPnP, UDP, RTSP, SMTP, NTP, DNS, DHCP, P2P, IP Filter, DDNS, 802.1X, SNMP, 3G/4G, PPPoE, ONVIF, SDK, CGI
